articleTitle: Modeling of experiments on the basis of nonlinear injection semiconductor lasers theory
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The formulas for intensity of output radiation from injection semiconductor laser are deduced. Paper shows that saturation effect is insignificant and the basic nonlinear effect in the semiconductor laser is playing a main role. Modeling a series of experiments is carried out.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of complex ultrasound and microwave irradiator
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The results of experimental investigation of complex ultrasound (US) and microwave (MW) irradiator in hydrogen containing medium are presented. It is shown that during concurrent operation US and MW units do not interfere. Thus, the US and MW units can be examined and adjusted independently.

articleTitle: Discrete interception problem research by methods of polyhedral programming
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The minimax and maximin problems of polyhedral programming with cost functions having the structure of polyhedral metric are discussed. The results are used for research on the discrete multistep interception game.

articleTitle: Modeling of a cumulative distribution function of electrons on energy for gas plasma
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The account of a cumulative distribution function of electrons on energies with the help of the Boltzmann equation on an interval from 0 up to 10 eV is conducted.

articleTitle: The problem of distinguishability of state space models
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The problem of distinguishability of state space model structures from input-output observations of the system is considered. We prove the proposition allowing to significantly simplify the system of algebraic equations solved in the symbolic form and, hence, to reduce the amount of required analytical computations. Two examples are given to illustrate the application of this approach.

articleTitle: High-Q tuned active bandpass filter for wireless application
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The paper presents a novel high-Q microwave tuned active bandpass filter using varactor diodes for tuning and a BJT to compensate for losses. The experimental filter with stepped resonator circuits and special coupling elements have been fabricated and tested demonstrating a good agreement with the circuit model predictions. Tuning range of 400 MHz for the active filter is achieved with the centre frequency of 1.6 GHz. A 3 dB bandwidth of 50 MHz is obtained and passband gain is typically 0.5-1.0 dB in the whole tuning range.

articleTitle: Polyhedral norms design and their application for discrete processes research
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: Questions of polyhedral norms design with the use of gauge functions of Minkowski, and their application for discrete processes research, are discussed.

articleTitle: Pyrolytic deposition of metal films on substrates in conditions of the open atmosphere initiated by nanosecond laser irradiation
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The analysis of conditions of pyrolytic deposition of films of metals initiated by a nanosecond laser exposure of a substrate in a mixture of organometallic vapors with noble gas at atmospheric pressure are presented. The processes of pyrolysis can occur both in the adsorbed layer, and in a gas phase.

articleTitle: Low-contrast images segmentation based on the Fourier spectrum approximation
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: In the most analysis and interpretation problems, the segmentation procedure is the key one: it allows to separate an image into parts, which are informatively interpreted and correspond to different objects in the image analyzed. It is shown that approximating the Fourier transform spectrum module of the image allows to approximately increase the contrast by 3.5 times. The results of this research show an acceptability of the suggested method for segmentation of low-contrast images.

articleTitle: Transfer function order identification on impulse response estimation
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The computerised analysis of the procedure of identification of discrete rational transfer function order, at reconstruction by noisy impulse response estimation, is submitted. The procedure of order identification is reduced to the analysis of population values of a specific functional shaped by impulse response estimation. The results testify to a high enough performance of the investigated functional.

articleTitle: Fuzzy models for intellectual industrial regulators in control systems of thermal power stations
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: This paper examines ideas proposed in a previous article by the author and the results of applying the theory of fuzzy sets and fuzzy logic to the analysis and diagnosis of the state of functioning power installations, which are represented as open MECHANISMS. Procedures are created and united into fuzzy production models for recognition of "generalized images of the state" of the elements (or nodes) of a power installation. Fuzzy models are applied for the first time in designing an intellectual fuzzy regulator for rarefaction in a turbine condenser.

articleTitle: Optimization algorithm parameters of an inverse filtration in conditions of a priori indeterminacy
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The accuracy increase of regularizing algorithms of the Volterra integral equations of 1-st order are considered. These problems describe tasks of dynamic objects identification and restoration of input signals for cases, when the effective power of a power spectrum of the required solution is concentrated in the limited frequencies band, including the almost periodic solutions. It is proposed to use filters with the minimal number of characteristic parameters, as a combination of Butterworth filters, as stabilizers in system-structural analogue of Tikhonov's regularization method.

articleTitle: Active current converter mathematical model and control
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The paper represents a totally controlled switches based active current rectifier working in a PWM mode vector mathematical model. The active current rectifier has certain advantages of output current management, energy recuperation, supply line power factor management and forming near sinusoidal line currents. The developed model can be used for electric drive vector control system synthesis. The presented approach also can be applied to current source inverter operating mode analysis. Simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: Maxwell's equations for amplifying medium and their application for laser analysis
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The characterization of amplification is defined: /spl eta/ specific amplification coefficient. Suggested Maxwell's equations for amplifying medium are used for derivation of amplitude condition of stationary generation for non-linear laser model and for derivation of system of equations for generation frequency and mode attenuation parameter. These equations are used for simulation of experiment series.

articleTitle: Ultrasonic and microwave irradiator for treatment of inner cavities
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The ultrasonic and microwave irradiator for treatment of inner cavities, fabricated on the lateral surface of urological metallic tube with embedded piezoceramic plate, is considered. An analytical model for estimation of insonation intensity is developed, and parameters for matching with lossy media are obtained. The developed mathematical model is validated by experiment.

articleTitle: The analysis of the pulsing signals propagation with an effective spectrum reaching a microwave range on basis of numerical methods of the inverse Laplace-transformation
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: At the propagation of impulses with small front rise time in communication lines there is a necessity of the analysis accuracy raising and extension of applicability borders of existing models. We consider application of the numerical methods of the Inverse Laplace transformation for analysis of deformations of pulsing signals propagating in transmission lines of TEM-wave.

articleTitle: The synthesis method of discrete controllers for nonlinear systems
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The synthesis method of the discrete control algorithms for automatic control systems of multi-input multi-output nonlinear nonstationary dynamic objects, with the limited norm of the controlling actions vector, is considered. The discrete model of the object is obtained by the approximation of the continuous model by the Euler formula, subject to the lag on a pitch. Resolvability conditions of the synthesis task, and basic relations for the account of the controller sampling period, are formulated. The controller is developed by the method of large gain factors.

articleTitle: Switched reluctance drive control system
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The results of development of the switched reluctance drive control system are presented. The switched reluctance drive control algorithm, without using the shaft position sensor, was developed. The control system with the phase switching off/on angle regulator was synthesized.

articleTitle: The etalonless method of vibroacoustic diagnostics
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: In operation the method of etalonless diagnostics of machines is offered on the basis of the analysis of vibroacoustic signals bound with unobservable errors of manufacture and operation. The part from errors has no adequate representation in dials of the ratio and intervals. The canonical coupling equation between diagnostic indications of a signal and structural state variables of the machine representing a bisectrix of the first angle of an information plane is deduced (removed), and the outcomes of model operation for a normal distribution are reduced.

articleTitle: Application of second harmonic generation to express local monitoring of semiconductor and dielectric crystal parameters
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: Physical and technical characteristics and possibilities of express, nondestructive, compatible with the existent technologies, computerized setup for ex-situ second harmonic generation diagnostics of crystal quality of semiconductor and dielectric plates and films without the center of symmetry (GaAs, CdTe, SBN) are presented. Brief characteristics of similar laboratory installation for in-situ express second harmonic generation diagnostics of semiconductor films crystal quality are given. The "ex-situ" setup is able to define the axes orientation with the accuracy about 0,1 degree by the analysis of the SH intensity dependence versus laser light polarization rotation with the space resolution up to 40 microns, operation time about 1 minute. It produces simultaneously the map of surface layer crystal quality distributions and the map of volume crystal and optical quality distributions. By this operation the thickness of studied surface layer 0,1-1 micron, the size of scanned area from 0,5/sup */0,5 mm/sup 2/ up to 60/sup */60 mm/sup 2/, number of map elements 100/sup */100, space resolution up to 40 microns, time of maps generation about 15 minutes. The demonstrated possibilities of SH testing of GaAs, CdTe, SBN quality give a chance to have convenient, express and technological tool for the laboratory and factory output inspection.

articleTitle: 4-digit linear converter of weak currents electrometric module
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The task was to design an easy-to-use and portable device used for a training course (e.g. for test measurements of p-n junction back current, I/sub /spl infin// of bipolar transistors, FET gate current, etc.). The device represents a portable adaptor to the digital voltmeter, designed as a module and a portable mains-operated power supply. It can also be powered by a self-contained source (two dry batteries with voltage 9 V). The modules can have 3 modifications.

articleTitle: Optimal frequencies for acoustic location
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The approach for determining of working frequencies for acoustic location is represented: the frequencies providing maximum of echo signal (J/sub e/) to background noise (J/sub n/) ratio are obtained. The general form relation is analysed for some particular cases.

articleTitle: Optical properties calculation of liquid crystal microlens and comparison with experiment
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The calculation of the director deformation of homeotropically aligned nematic in axially-symmetrical electrical field of an asymmetrical liquid crystal microlens (LCM) were carried out. The calculation results of microlenses phase profiles and focal distance are in satisfactory accordance with experimental values.

articleTitle: Inverse filtration of two-dimensional signals on basis of the regulation method by A.N. Tikhonov (the structural approach)
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: Realization of restoration algorithms of two-dimensional input signals operating in the entry of the dynamic system is suggested as two-dimensional inversion filters which characteristics are determined by the methods of regulation by A.N. Tikhonov. Using the structural analysis of this method, the requirements on the parameters of the inversion filter is specified and their influence on its dynamic characteristics is investigated.

articleTitle: Structure and optical properties of liquid-crystal composites with induced helices
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The authors study the structure and electrooptical properties of LC composites containing nematic liquid crystals (of the cyanbiphenyl type) with optically active dopants (members of the 1R, 4R-2-(-4phenylbellzilidene)-p-methane-3-ons with variable length of the terminal alcyl substitute) and a polymer (polyvinylpyrrolidone, PVP) network.

articleTitle: Excitation conditions for the distributed generator with a ring resonator oscillating system
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: We determine the excitation conditions for the distributed generator with a ring resonator excited by several dependent sources. The resonator is formed by the segments of an artificial transmission line, and contains a distributed load, which can be provided by the plasma of the gas discharge maintained by the resonator field. The possible field patterns in a ring resonator are discussed.

articleTitle: Difference equation reconstruction algorithms based on generalized least square method
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The possibilities and singularities of the use of the maximum likelihood method, for an improvement in the estimation of denominator polynomial factors at reconstruction of object discrete transfer function on noisy estimation of its impulse response, are considered. The application of this method reduces the necessity of a nonlinear algebraic system solution. A special iterative algorithm of solution of the system is proposed, on which each step, the solution of two linear systems is made. In this case the reconstruction error of the required factors is generated by an arbitrary choice of shaping filter transfer function order, and by the iterative character of a nonlinear system solution. The procedure of indirect monitoring of the obtained estimation effectiveness, by means of inspection of indices of centrality, whiteness and normality of generating noise estimation, is proposed.

articleTitle: Adaptive systems of etalonless diagnostics of machines
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The adaptive rank systems of etalonless diagnostics of machines are offered and the error analysis of systems introduced on practice is carried out. It is shown, that the error of an estimation of a rank of vibroacoustic indications submits to the uniform law and is estimated by methods of a nonparametric statistician, the two-threshold test of a state estimation of machines ensuring a minimum control errors for a given measuring error of a rank is offered.

articleTitle: Influence of orientational phase transition in conductivity of fullerene-iodine films
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The synthesis and research of intercalated fullerene are greatly significant in understanding for this new molecular modification of carbon. Here we report the results of conductive properties of fullerene-iodine compound films. It is found that there are strong changes in the temperature dependence of the conductivity in range of 240-250 K which can be concerned with orientational phase transition of fullerene molecule. It should be noted that the value of changes of conductivity much more strong than in pure fullerene films.

articleTitle: Investigation of semiconductors and low-dimensional systems by magneto-optical and microwave methods
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: In this paper the investigation of the quantum effects in semiconductors by the contactless magneto-optical and microwave methods are presented. Studies of the dependence of the optical and microwave Shubnikov-de Haas (SdH) effect on magnetic field have been carried out to determine the transport and energetic parameters in semiconductors such as InSb, Cd/sub x/Hg/sub 1-x/Te and two-dimensional systems (2DS) such GaAs/Al/sub x/Ga/sub 1-x/As in the observation of this effect in the transmission and reflectivity of the probing radiation. The nonlinear spin resonance raised in n-InSb due to stimulated combinational light scattering method (LSCS) with the signal amplification is considered.

articleTitle: Truncated system's method in the tasks of dynamic correction
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The task of synthesis regularizing, high-speed, capable to operate in conditions of restricted computing operational lifes of restoring algorithms of input signals implemented on the basis of representation by matrices. Tikhonov's regularization a method in a basis of synthesis is put. The original approach to synthesis of high-speed matrix algorithms of signals restoring permitting to use for solution of the obtained system of the linear algebraic equations (LAE) with a Toeplitz matrix more effective modification of solutions method of the truncated systems is offered.

articleTitle: An analysis of possibility of an ionizing radiation detector development on the base of a heterobipolar amplification element
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: An analysis of operation of an ionizing radiation detector on the base of the transistor heterostructure AlGaAs has been carried out. It has been shown that in such a detector there is a possibility to magnify a signal from one gamma quantum. A three-dimensional pattern of the electric field created by a bunch of non-equilibrium holes has been taking into account for the analysis.

articleTitle: Weak localization in p-type inversion channels on silicon
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: Experimental results on the magnetoresistance in p-type inversion channels on the [111] silicon surface are presented. Experiments were conducted at temperature of 4.2 /spl deg/K, magnetic field magnitudes of up to 3 Tesla and gate voltages on the MOS-structures generating hole concentration of /spl Gamma//sub p//spl cong/10/sup 13/ cm/sup -2/ in inversion channel. Having compared theory with the experimental results for B/sub /spl perp// we have obtained that (0.5+/spl beta/)/spl cong/0.501, L/sub /spl phi///spl cong/6.1/spl middot/10/sup -8/ m, L/sub /spl phi///sup *//spl cong/4.8/spl middot/10/sup -9/ m, /spl tau//sub /spl phi////spl tau//sub /spl phi///sup *//spl cong/80. In the case of B/sub /spl par// have obtained that up to B/sub /spl par//=2 T, /spl tau//sub /spl phi////spl tau//sub B/spl par//spl caron///spl ap/0.6/spl middot/B/sup 2/ and /spl tau//sub /spl phi///sup *///spl tau//sub B/spl par//spl caron///spl ap/20.

articleTitle: Evolution of relief of asperited polycrystalline silicon surface in the process of thermal oxidation
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: A simple phenomenological model of changing asperity surface, in the process of thermal oxidation of polycrystalline silicon, is examined. This allows to prognosticate and consequently deliberately change electrical characteristics of the dielectric layer.

articleTitle: Equivalent dynamic thermal model for polysilicon resistor
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The equivalent dynamic heat model for polysilicon resistor is considered. The resistor is modelled as the an inertial heat link of the second order. The physical meaning of the equivalent parameters is presented as well as experimental values.

articleTitle: The low energy gas discharge electron sources with injection of beams through the gas dynamic windows
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: Research results of increase of efficiency of injection in atmosphere of electron beams, with energy up to 100 keV, from electron sources based on high-voltage smolder discharge, through gas dynamic window with the differential gas pumping, are presented. Increased injection efficiency is reached by increase of working pressure of the electron source up to 80 Pa, using the gas dynamic effects and electrophysical phenomena for increasing pressure swing.

articleTitle: Estimation of flexibility of power electronic systems
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: A method of a quantitative estimation of flexibility of systems of power supplies with variable structure, based on the application of the Sugeno fuzzy integral, is proposed. The parameter of efficiency of reaggregation is defined, and its properties are specified. The results can be applied to the design of power electronic devices.

articleTitle: Series resonant full bridge converter with phase shifted controls and quasi-soft switching action of power switches for wide range load changing
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The 25 kHz 20 kW AC/DC converter has been developed for high-voltage power supplies. The converter is designed with a series resonant H-bridge topology. PWM phase shifted control for power switches based on IC UCC3895 makes available high efficiency and noiseless performance of the power supply. In this converter electrolytic capacitors are absent in the high power circuit.

articleTitle: Plastic flow of metal due to thermomechanical effect of a laser ray
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The use of plastic flow of metal due to thermomechanical effect of a laser ray allows to apply this effect to shaping volumetric constructions of micromechanics in thin films with the purpose of creation of devices such as microcoolers, extra small gas and fluid chromatographs, and microlens matrix optics.

articleTitle: Waveguide filter on multiresonant diaphragms
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: To increase the steepness of slopes of frequency response of waveguide filters with /spl lambda//4 coupling as resonant tanks, it is possible to use multiresonance diaphragms. A broad spectrum of the highest evanescent types of waves is launched on such diaphragms. For an isolation on the highest modes the additional resonance diaphragms with low-loaded Q-factor are fixed between resonant diaphragms. An example of such a five-section filter on multiresonance is shown.

articleTitle: The model of process of low-temperature plasmachemical treatment of units of CRPhED
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The application of the model of plasma gap for process of low-temperature plasmachemical treatment of units of cathode-ray and photoelectronic devices (CRPhED) is considered. The model allows to consider potential distribution in the gap as similar to potential distribution without plasma. The model gives the possibility to calculate potential on the electrodes, necessary for the quality cleaning of workpieces.

articleTitle: Particular features of signal reception in a photoreceiving channel
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The process of detection of signals in a photoreceiving channel is connected to a series of particular phenomena of transient occurrence in a slugged link of a photodetector. In view of these phenomena, the problems of quasi-optimal selection of parameters of the channel are estimated.

articleTitle: Laser tomography of the lifetime and diffusion length of charge carriers in semiconductor silicon ingots
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: A nondestructive method for estimating quality of single-crystal Si ingots is proposed. The method provides a three-dimensional pattern of the lifetime and diffusion length of charge carriers inside Si ingots up to 300 mm in diameter and 1 m in length. The method employs laser-induced photoinjection of charge carriers followed by laser-assisted monitoring of their spatial distributions and time evolution in any part of the ingot.

articleTitle: Uncertainty of reproduction of units of wave resistance and angle of phase shift by a section of coaxial line
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: For measuring of S parameters of two-port networks in coaxial waveguides, a wide distribution was received by automatic network analyzers calibrated by devices which are standards of the value of units of measurands. The wide distribution for calibrations was received by a section of precision coaxial air dielectric line (air line) with the given parameters. In particular, the basic element of reproduction of units of wave resistance (UWR) and angle of phase shift (UAPS) and transmission of their sizes in the national measurement standard UWR in coaxial waveguides and in national installation of high accuracy of UAPS in coaxial waveguides is an air line. The improvement of a model of a real air line is discussed.

articleTitle: Compression of thermographic images in welding engineering: a comparative study
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: This contribution investigates different coding methods in application to the compression of thermographic images which were captured on-line for an off-line inspection of welding joints. On-line recording of images enables a complete quality checking. The standard coding algorithm JPEG (Joint Photographic Experts Group), a wavelet-based coding scheme and a DPCM-based (differential pulse code modulation) algorithm are compared with regard to the requirements of real-time applications and minimal loss of information.

articleTitle: Active jamming compensation in complex location systems
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: A possibility of mutual active jamming compensation in complex location systems is considered. An adaptive signal processing algorithm in a priori indetermination conditions is proposed. This algorithm implies the evaluation of jamming spectral density and interchannel jamming correlation coefficients and the removal of carrier frequency difference in the channels.

articleTitle: Permolecular structures formation during phase transition of liquid crystals
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The influence of liquid crystal (LC) thermotropic characteristics, alignment layer and phase boundary surface on the planar, homeotropic and focal conic structures of smectic A (SA) LC during S/sub A/-N phase transition was investigated. The data obtained can be used for LC-filling display technology and for enhance of LCD image quality.

articleTitle: Investigation of rapidly quenched Nd-Fe-B alloys for production of high-coercivity composite magnets
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The paper is devoted to producing and studying magnetic properties of rapidly quenched neodymium-iron-boron based alloys (RQA). Extreme dependence of coercive force upon quenching ratio and alloy chemical composition (neodymium and boron content) is shown. Particles produced by quenching are shown to be X-ray amorphous and isotropic. By means of thermal influence it is possible to improve the magnetic characteristics of RQA and powders on their basis. The optimal annealing temperature is 600...800/spl deg/C. Composite magnets, produced from the above RQA have the following properties: B/sub r/=0,53 T, /sub i/H/sub c/=1100 kA/m.

articleTitle: One approach to representation and implementation of query to the distributed database
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The problems of representation and implementation of queries to the distributed database (DDB) by the natural language are considered. One of the approaches of building of unplanned queries, on the basis of representation of conceptual model as the hypergraph, is described. The task of finding of the shortest path between sets of graph vertexes for optimal execution of query and some means's of its solution is defined.

articleTitle: Buck-boost AC-AC frequency converters
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: Transformerless buck-boost AC-AC frequency converters are investigated. They constitute by combination of the matrix converters and the output part of the new buck-boost AC voltage controllers. The unified direct method of calculation of such converters are developed.

articleTitle: Coefficients and functionals of sensitivity for continuous many-dimensional dynamic systems described by integral equations with delay time
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The variational method of calculation of sensitivity coefficients (components of vector gradient from quality function to constant parameters) and sensitivity functionals (connecting first variation of quality function with variations of variable parameters) for multivariate nonlinear dynamic systems, described by continuous Volterra integral equations of the second order with delay time, is developed. The basis of calculation is the decision of corresponding integral conjugate equations for Lagrange multipliers in reverse order (on time).

articleTitle: Design of digital control systems with two-time-scale motions
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The problem of digital controller design is discussed. The design method is based on the formation of two-time scale motions in the closed loop system. It is shown that, if a sufficient time-scale separation between the fast and slow modes in the discussed closed loop system and stability of fast modes are provided, then slow modes have the desired form. Thus, the output transient performance indices are insensitive to external disturbances. Relationships for control accuracy analysis and choice of the sampling period are obtained. Finally, an example with simulation results is presented.

articleTitle: The magnetic sensor with a frequency output
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: We present the results of experimental research and developments the magnetic sensor with a frequency output, constructed on effect of a helical instability of electron-hole plasma in silicon. The sensor execute direct conversion of a flux density to frequency of high-frequency generation and may be used in the computer informational-measuring system.

articleTitle: Anomalous thermomagnetic effect in semiconductor heterojunctions
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: In a two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG) with asymmetric quantizing potential in the presence of magnetic field parallel to the 2DEG plane due to different interaction between electron system and phonons having mutually opposite directions of wave vectors the anomalous thermomagnetic effect appears. The alternating uniform heating of the crystal lattice results in emergence of alternating electromotive force. The effect is analyzed for interaction between electron system and acoustic phonons (both usual and piezoelectric) in heterojunction GaAs-AlGaAs.

articleTitle: The study on electro-physical properties of sandwich structure based on fullerene films
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: We report the technology of sandwich structure based on fullerene films and experimental results in research of optical and conductivity properties of sandwich samples. The single-crystal of sapphire [100] or silicon was used as a substrate. The sandwich specimens were based on structure M/C/sub 60/ fullerene film/M (M=Cr,Pd,Ag,Al,Cu). The thickness of fullerene films /spl sim/0.2-1.0 /spl mu/m. The area of C/sub 60/ film under the top contact /spl sim/1 cm/sup 2/. The specimens have been investigated in IR-spectroscopy, spectra-photometry, ellipsometry and XRD. The measurements of I-V characteristics and research in temperature dependence of conductivity were made as well. It was shown that metals as Cr, Pd, Ag, Al, Cu penetrates easy in fullerene film. It appears that specimens show the large value of conductivity. Silver/C/sub 60/ structure and other sandwich structures show semiconductor behaviour of conductivity.

articleTitle: Degradation process research of microelectromechanical structures of pressure transducers
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The paper analyses temperature hysteresis of pressure transducer output signal and reveals its regular change with time. A mathematical model of hysteresis temporal increase is created, and its effect on reliability of pressure transducers is determined.

articleTitle: Low-field mobility and piezoresistivity of holes in germanium and silicon
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: A theoretical calculation of the low-field mobility and piezoresistance coefficients of holes in germanium and silicon is carried out incorporating all relevant details of the band structure. The scattering have been limited to acoustic and optical phonons and ionized-impurity and is described by the deformation potentials a, b, d and d/sub 0/. Values of the piezoresistance coefficients are calculated using matrix 6/spl times/6 expressions for the strain dependent energy-wave vector relations of the valence bands and the known deformation potentials. The calculated values of the first-order piezoresistance coefficients are found to agree fairly well with the experimental data.

articleTitle: Fabrication technology of optical waveguides on glasses
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: Fabrication technology of optoelectronic elements on glasses, as substitute of elements on crystals, is considered. A waveguide is prepared by formation of a film of lead oxide using standard thermovacuum sputtering equipment with the following diffusion at the atmospheric pressure.

articleTitle: Thick-film Josephson transition on Al/sub 2/O/sub 3/ substrate
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: Josephson transitions based on new thick film technology are made. The main difference of the new technology is that the operation of a mould of ceramic slices in the forms combine with the operation of manufacturing of microcontour. In this case the silicon slices with a required microcontour in side walls of casting forms are pasted.

articleTitle: Plasma-chemical deposition of nitrides out of halogenides
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: Constructions of MW PGs and of reactors relevanted have been worked out, modes of ultrafine powders' and films' deposition of some metal nitrides out of their chlorides in nitrogen plasma now under atmosphere pressure have been researched. Process of film's formation has diffusional character, growth rate has been controlled by diffusion transfer of volatile halogenides of metal towards substrate's surface. During its formation the film undergoes the stages of nucleation and growth of nuclei. As the temperature of substrate is less than 1000 K processes of coalescence and of secondary recrystallization in a growing layer being hindered, that have resulted in a sharping decrease of a grain size. Values of deposition rate achieved have been about (10/sup 2/-10/sup 3/) A/s. In case of nitride and oxide temperature regions be separated the films obtained have been monophase and disoxidic ones.

articleTitle: The vacuum plasma electric furnace for industrial melting of tantalum ingots from thermo-sodium raw powder
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: New technologies and industrial setups, of powdered material heating directly in a plasma column, have appeared with the development of electric furnaces with hollow cathode arc plasma generators. This has essentially improved the efficiency and economics of producing high melting temperature and high activity metals. The electric furnace for tantalum ingot melting is described, and some melting parameters are given.

articleTitle: Increase of quality of an output voltage in rebuilding converter networks
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The organization of operatively rebuilding converter networks, using pulse-amplitude modulation for improvement of harmonic structure of an output voltage is presented. A tensor model, of a network constructed on the basis of inverters of voltage, is developed. The results of the research are given.

articleTitle: Three-band waveguide filter
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: A waveguide filter, having one stopband and two passbands is described. The filter is built on a network with direct couplings on a three-element reactive discontinuity.

articleTitle: Laser-photodynamic therapy of brain tumors
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: The purpose of this study was to develop methods of brain tumor PDT, based on locoregional injection of photosensitive substance in liquor system. The first experience in performing this PDT procedure showed that it is well endured by patients with brain tumors. MRI and clinical examinations of patients 14 months after PDT revealed the absence of continued tumor growth. All this testifies to the favourable preconditions for further development and application of this treatment technique in neurooncology.

articleTitle: Influence of high-frequency electrotechnological installations on generation of harmonics in a network
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: An investigation of the harmonics generation problem is a complicated task due to the wish to have the exact description of the problem that leads to a large volume of necessary calculations and experiments. The coupling simulation of network and electrotechnological installations, for example, 400 kW/0.44 MHz, which can correspond, for example, to HF generator, is a very complicated task due to the large frequency ratio (more then 8000 times) between network and installation that leads to the significant increase of the calculation time. At the same time, coupling simulation gives full and exact information about harmonics generation in a network. But electromagnetic processes in the HF electrical part of the generator have steady-state values in the time range 40-100 /spl mu/s. Besides, the HF generator contains low frequency filter elements that prevent the HF harmonics (0.44 MHz and above) penetration in a network and permit to define the level of network harmonics with a good accuracy. The different frequency characteristics of the network-generator system, and their comparison with time-domain study, are overviewed.

articleTitle: On the cooperation between APEIE and IEEE in the period 1996-2000
publicationTitle: 2000 5th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-2000. Devoted to the 50th Anniversary of Novosibirsk State Technical University. Vol.1 (Cat
abstract: For the fifth time the local electronic community has organized the International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instruments Engineering (APEIE'2000) to attract Russian and loreign specialists for discussion on some selected topics of their academic and/or industrial interests. Based on active support from ED-S, CPMT-S and SSC-S the appropriate Professional Groups have been formed by the local Chapter which consists now of about 80 members. Permanently being in touch with local professionals we have understood that there exist a good potential for increasing number of EEE members in West Siberia. As a result the Novosibirsk Chapter has been recently extended towards Solid-state Circuits Society. New LEO-S Chapter has been launched as well as ED Student Branch. Besides, new Chapter has been launched in Tomsk last year.
